value.rationale: A natural frame family for a nonnormal epistemic modality displays a sharp boundary between finite-frame stabilization and an all-depth strict hierarchy. The P4 classification is the first finite path needing modal depth three and identifies its complete 16384-element formula algebra; the P5 and P6 profiles further quantify growth. A general exact type refinement and an explicit d+2-world witness supply structural results beyond an isolated small computation. The problem is motivated by expressivity under information-agreement modalities, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
